title: ACR MCP source_evidence Request v1
description: Input for the source_evidence tool. evidence_ref_id is required. result_id is required for a Context Fabric reference (acr:v1:...), which is keyed by its subject and expands only in the scope of the answer that returned it.

evidence_ref_id.description: An evidence reference exactly as a previous context_for_task or investigate_question response returned it (its evidence_ref_ids, or an evidence reference on a context item). Opaque: pass it back unchanged; never build or parse one yourself.

result_id.description: The result_id of the investigate_question answer that returned evidence_ref_id. Required when evidence_ref_id is a Context Fabric reference (acr:v1:...): the reference names its subject, not its answer, so without the result_id the citation of a different result could be returned. Opaque: pass it back unchanged.
